items.title: Loren Schoenberg interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 14, 2019
items.q: we just got a million dollars from Congress from Ted Stevens.

ctx.x: a great pianist. People said oh he rushed or he didn’t have a jazz feel. Who cares what he did. He was a brilliant orchestrator. Monk you would love this. He could sit down, like you could ask him to play a tune he hadn’t played in thirty years. He’d sit down and he’d play and he’d find his key, and what would come out of the piano would sound like a Billy Strayhorn arrangement. I mean he spontaneously could do that. I mean and he loved Ellington I mean that was his whole life was Ivy Anderson and Duke Ellington…
